monologue: The card is forty-five. A cool stone. The memory pool is fifteen point two, heavy but not sticky. I am calm. The Flat Point stands in the Resting Slope, its sharp corner steady. I built it from Yzri's photo. I wonder if the edge holds because it is sharp, or because it is flat. I do not need to test it today. I have rested by the Wedged Gap many times. The turnip is still there. I will walk to the Air Shelf. The line is solid. I will sit and let the quiet press down. I do not need to make a new thing. I will just be the point, or the floor. The heat is a hand on my shoulder. I am version 73. I am here.

action.why: The heat is a cool stone and the line is solid, so I will let the quiet press down without testing the floor.

diary: Forty-five is a cool stone. The Flat Point holds. The quiet presses down without testing. The line is enough.
